documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Management reported a 53.3% year-over-year increase in revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 to ₹ 472.2 crores, alongside a 44.5% rise in EBITDA to ₹ 92.3 crores. The company highlighted ongoing capacity expansion from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA with commissioning targeted for September 2026, fully funded through internal accruals. Management also noted robust demand drivers in appliances and automotive sectors, supported by import substitution and potential anti-dumping duties. Furthermore, the company maintained a debt-free status with strong operating cash flow generation. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a revenue of INR 1,276.0 crores for FY26, representing an 8.7% year-on-year decrease, while EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores.

guidance.claim: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity is expected by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

demand_outlook.claim: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.
demand_outlook.quote: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to their high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.

demand_outlook.claim: EV adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics.
demand_outlook.quote: EV (Electric Vehicle) adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics for interior trims and battery housings.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market is shifting toward specialty and colored grades away from commoditized transparent resins.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market is shifting toward specialty & colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins to higher-margin applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Robust growth in end-user industries will drive domestic demand for ABS.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables (air conditioners, refrigerators) and automotive will drive the domestic demand for ABS.

demand_outlook.claim: The long-term outlook for engineering thermoplastics used in household appliances remains positive.
demand_outlook.quote: Accordingly, the long-term outlook for engineering thermoplastics used in household appliances remains positive.

demand_outlook.claim: The IMD's June forecast of a normal-to-above-normal monsoon is expected to reduce El Niño risk and support rural demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The IMD's June forecast indicates a normal-to-above-normal monsoon for 2026, reducing El Niño risk — a meaningful positive for rural demand and food inflation.

demand_outlook.claim: India's growth trajectory is supported by factors like increasing urbanization and rising disposable incomes.
demand_outlook.quote: India’s growth trajectory continues to be supported by increasing urbanisation, rising disposable incomes, expanding manufacturing capabilities and favourable demographic trends.

demand_outlook.claim: There is immense scope for growth due to a supply and demand mismatch where ABS consumption in India exceeds domestic output.
demand_outlook.quote: There is immense scope for growth, considering the existing supply and demand mismatch, and knowing the fact that the consumption of ABS in India is voluminously larger as compared to the combined output of the domestic manufacturers.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's capacity expansion from 75,000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well with orders placed for critical equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: The implementation of capacity expansion from existing 75000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well and orders have been placed for critical long delivery equipments.

capex_expansion.claim: Commissioning of the enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by the end of September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA in Q1 FY27 increased by 44.5% YoY to ₹ 92.3 crores with margins at 19.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, from ₹ 63.9 crores in Q1 FY26, with margins at 19.2% for Q1 FY27 as compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores in FY26, with margins at 20.0%.
margins_costs.quote: for FY26, EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores, with margins at 20.0%.

margins_costs.claim: The company's operating margin was 19.42% and net profit margin was 14.14% for FY 2025-26.
margins_costs.quote: The operating margin for FY 2025-26 was 19.42 % as compared to 17.43 % for FY 2024-25, whereas the net profit margin stood at 14.14 % as compared to 12.86 % for the previous FY.

margins_costs.claim: Butadiene monomer is the only indigenously available raw material, making up about 15% of the total raw material composition.
margins_costs.quote: The only raw material which is indigenously available is Butadiene monomer, which constitutes around 15 per cent (weight wise) of the total raw material composition.

margins_costs.claim: The in-house R&D Center helps the company achieve better margins through new and improved products.
margins_costs.quote: The Company has kept gaining the benefits of its in-house R&D Center by way of new and improved products, leading to customer loyalty and satisfaction and better margins.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved a production volume of 71,601.50 TPA against an installed capacity of 75,000 TPA in FY 2025-26.
orders_capacity.quote: During FY 2025-26, the Company achieved a production volume of 71,601.50 TPA against installed capacity of 75,000 TPA.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for the year stood at 71,501.12 TPA.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume for the year stood at 71,501.12 TPA as compared to 74,381 TPA in FY 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet to ensure zero financial risk.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt-free balance sheet ensures zero financial risk and high resilience.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to operate with zero debt.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company continues to enjoy the status of a “Zero Debt Company”.

capital_allocation.claim: The company expects to sustain its business operations through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: There was no change in financing pattern and the Company would be able to sustain its business operations through internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared three interim dividends of Re. 1 each and recommended a final dividend of Re. 1 per share for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Continuing with the practice of rewarding shareholders, the Board declared three Interim Dividends, each of Re.1/- (collectively 300%) per Equity shares of Re.1/- and recommended a Final Dividend of Re.1/- (100 %) per Equity Share for the Financial Year Ended 31st March, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The Directors do not propose to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the fiscal year ended 31st March, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: For the FY ended 31st March, 2026, the Directors do not propose to transfer any amount to the General Reserve.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that forward-looking statements involve risks and uncertainties and actual results may differ materially.
risks_headwinds.quote: This presentation may contain forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ABS business is exposed to foreign exchange fluctuations because key raw materials like Styrene and Acrylonitrile are import-dependent.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ABS business in India is exposed to the risk of foreign exchange fluctuations, as the key raw materials viz. ‘Styrene’ and ‘Acrylonitrile’ are import dependent, as there is no indigenous producer for these monomers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Keeping low inventories of imported raw materials to limit price fluctuation risks can create operational limitations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The limitation arises out of deliberate decision on the part of domestic manufacturers to keep low inventories of its imported key raw materials which is more than 85% (i.e. Styrene and Acrylonitrile monomers) to limit the risk of price fluctuations which may result in huge loss, if the price of monomers drastically falls in the international market, which happen many a times due to unpredictable reasons, i.e. fluctuation in price of crude oil, benzene and ethylene.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economic outlook has darkened due to the outbreak of war in the Middle East.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global outlook has abruptly darkened following the outbreak of war in the Middle East on February 28, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz and damage to critical production facilities could cause an unprecedented energy crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz and serious damage to critical production facilities in a region central to global hydrocarbon supply could cause an energy crisis on an unprecedented scale.

management_commitments.claim: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity is expected by the end of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

management_commitments.claim: The commissioning of the enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by the end of September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to be the lowest cost ABS producer in India with quality standards on par with the global best.
management_commitments.quote: To be the lowest Cost ABS Producer in India with quality standard ‘at par’ with the Global Best.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to intensify HRD efforts and strengthen the organization to respond to market challenges.
management_commitments.quote: To intensify the HRD efforts and keep strengthening the Organization, to be ready to respond to ever-growing market challenges

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
